name: The Jasperlode Mine
label: Quest
description: Following the discovery that kobolds have overrun the Fargodeep Mine, Marshal Dughan tasks scouts with investigating the Jasperlode Mine further east.…
intro: Following the discovery that kobolds have overrun the Fargodeep Mine, Marshal Dughan tasks scouts with investigating the Jasperlode Mine further east. Reaching the site confirms the worst: the infestation has spread across Elwynn's vital mineral veins, stretching Stormwind's remaining defenders past their limits.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Thanks to you we know the Fargodeep Mine is infested with kobolds. Now we need a scout to investigate the more distant Jasperlode Mine.

Explore Jasperlode and confirm any kobold presence. To reach the mine, travel east along the road until you reach the Tower of Azora. From the tower, head north and you'll find the mine in the foothills.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Hail, friend. What do you have to report? Have you scouted the Jasperlode Mine?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Kobolds at the Jasperlode Mine, you say? Curses! The situation is worsening by the minute!
Thank you for the report, friend. But I wish that the news you brought was good news.

sources.title: Quest text as quoted on the Warcraft Wiki
